differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned close to the tiles, creating a tight composition where the yellow and blue buttons dominate the frame.
differences.b_observable: The camera is further away, showing a wider view with smaller buttons and more surrounding empty tiles.
differences.fix: Move the camera closer to the subject and adjust the field of view to match the tight framing of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the image are noticeably darker than the center due to a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: The lighting is flat and even across the frame, with no corner darkening.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect to darken the outer edges of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The overall image has a warm, yellowish color cast, especially visible on the white tiles.
differences.b_observable: The image has a neutral to cool blue-grey color cast.
differences.fix: Adjust the color temperature of the lights or color grade the output to add a warm tint.

differences.a_observable: The background tiles in the upper-right corner are heavily blurred by a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background tiles in the upper-right corner are sharp and clearly defined.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field in the camera settings and set a wider aperture to blur the background.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera position, focal length, and depth of field to match the close-up, blurred-background composition of the reference video.
